expected_inputs.name: review-findings
expected_inputs.meaning: The findings of a completed run of spacing-review (E1b), naming the rows examined.

expected_inputs.name: design-criteria
expected_inputs.meaning: The engineer's supports-review report file in the App project (AF-1), supplied to the run.
expected_inputs.basis_requirement: The file's content identity is recorded when it is supplied (⟨AF-1@f1⟩).

expected_inputs.name: run
expected_inputs.meaning: The run whose supports are to be approved (for example R-100).

required_tools.name: read-supports
required_tools.purpose: Read the supports on the run.

required_tools.name: read-loads
required_tools.purpose: Read the sustained-load results for LC-1.

required_tools.name: write-package
required_tools.purpose: Write the approval package file into the App project.

checkpoints.name: CP-approve
checkpoints.scope: The approval package file as written.
checkpoints.purpose: The engineer gives or withholds engineering approval of the support arrangement the package describes.

on_negative_decision.explanation: Stop and report that approval was not given.

expected_act_evidence.description: The App act control's record of A6 on the file's content identity, with its capture-evidence reference (EXEC §5; the control is DEL-01-04's).

checkpoints.name: CP-rely
checkpoints.scope: The sustained-load result rows the load findings name, as read.
checkpoints.purpose: The accountable professional decides whether to rely on these sustained-load results for the support design.

on_negative_decision.explanation: Stop and report that reliance was not given.

expected_act_evidence.description: The host's act record of A7 by the accountable professional, bound to each result row's subject content identity as read, with its capture-evidence reference.

returned_outputs.name: approval-package
returned_outputs.meaning: A file describing the support arrangement and the findings it answers, for the engineer's approval.

returned_outputs.name: load-findings
returned_outputs.meaning: The sustained-load results for LC-1, with their read basis and the rows they concern, by reference.

returned_evidence.name: EV-approve-act
returned_evidence.meaning: The human-act record of A6 with its capture-evidence reference.

returned_evidence.name: EV-rely-act
returned_evidence.meaning: The human-act record of A7 by the accountable professional.

returned_evidence.name: EV-loads-basis
returned_evidence.meaning: The relied-on read basis of the load results.
